stages.name: ordered_occurrences
stages.query: SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,class_name,function_name ORDER BY __start,__end DESC) AS occurrence FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.__start,n.__end,coalesce((SELECT s.name FROM scope_classes s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.__start<=n.__start AND s.__end>=n.__end ORDER BY s.__end-s.__start LIMIT 1),'<module>') AS class_name,coalesce((SELECT s.name FROM scope_fns s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.__start<=n.__start AND s.__end>=n.__end ORDER BY s.__end-s.__start LIMIT 1),'<module>') AS function_name FROM ordered n)

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-053' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM ordered_occurrences n WHERE n.occurrence>coalesce((SELECT maximum FROM ordered_limits lim WHERE lim.path=n.__path AND lim.class_name=n.class_name AND lim.function_name=n.function_name),0)

stages.name: last_methods
stages.query: SELECT * FROM pair_methods m WHERE m.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM pair_methods o WHERE o.__path=m.__path AND o.cls=m.cls AND o.name=m.name)

stages.name: last_functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM pair_functions m WHERE m.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM pair_functions o WHERE o.__path=m.__path AND o.name=m.name)

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-001' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM pair_methods n JOIN last_methods sync ON sync.__path=n.__path AND sync.cls=n.cls AND sync.name=substr(n.name,1,length(n.name)-6) WHERE substr(n.name,-6)='_async' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM abstract_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start IN (n.__start,sync.__start)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM long_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start IN (n.__start,sync.__start)) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-001' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM pair_functions n JOIN last_functions sync ON sync.__path=n.__path AND sync.name=substr(n.name,1,length(n.name)-6) WHERE substr(n.name,-6)='_async' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM long_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start IN (n.__start,sync.__start))

stages.name: imperative
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE imperative(__path,name) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,name FROM preop_seeds UNION SELECT f.__path,f.name FROM preop_fns f JOIN preop_calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start>f.__start AND c.__end<=f.__end JOIN imperative i ON i.__path=c.__path AND i.name=c.callee) SELECT * FROM imperative

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-020' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM preop_steps n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM imperative i WHERE i.__path=n.__path AND i.name=n.value)

stages.name: module_string_values
stages.query: SELECT * FROM module_strings s WHERE s.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM module_strings o WHERE o.__path=s.__path AND o.name=s.name)

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-042' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM filter_names n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM module_string_values s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.name=n.name AND s.value IN ('branch_id','revision_id'))

stages.name: loop_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,fn,loop_start,loop_end,name FROM statement_loops UNION SELECT __path,fn,loop_start,loop_end,name FROM comprehension_loops

stages.name: repaired
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT l.__path,l.fn FROM loop_names l JOIN (SELECT __path,name,call_start,call_end FROM dict_refs UNION ALL SELECT __path,name,call_start,call_end FROM dump_refs) r ON r.__path=l.__path AND r.name=l.name AND r.call_start>=l.loop_start AND r.call_end<=l.loop_end

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-043' AS issue,n.__start AS identity FROM executing_fns n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repaired r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.fn=n.__start)

stages.name: scope_nodes
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start AS id,__start,__end,'function_definition' AS kind,name FROM fn_scopes UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__start,__end,'class_definition',name FROM class_scopes

stages.name: annotations
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,a.__start,a.__end,coalesce((SELECT s.id FROM scope_nodes s WHERE s.__path=a.__path AND s.id<a.__start AND s.__end>=a.__end ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1) AS scope FROM annotated a

stages.name: scopes
stages.query: SELECT s.__path,s.id,coalesce((SELECT f.id FROM scope_nodes f WHERE f.__path=s.__path AND f.kind='function_definition' AND f.id<s.id AND f.__end>=s.__end ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1) AS enclosing FROM scope_nodes s UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT __path,-1,NULL FROM annotations

stages.name: scope_chain
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE chain(__path,scope,ancestor,depth) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,scope,scope,0 FROM annotations UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.scope,s.enclosing,c.depth+1 FROM chain c JOIN scopes s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.id=c.ancestor WHERE s.enclosing IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM chain

stages.name: scope_imports
stages.query: SELECT i.__path,coalesce((SELECT s.id FROM scope_nodes s WHERE s.__path=i.__path AND s.id<i.__start AND s.__end>=i.__end ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1) AS scope,coalesce(i.alias,i.name) AS name,i.module||'.'||i.name AS origin FROM from_imports i UNION SELECT i.__path,coalesce((SELECT s.id FROM scope_nodes s WHERE s.__path=i.__path AND s.id<i.__start AND s.__end>=i.__end ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1),coalesce(i.alias,rx_extract(i.name,'^[^.]+',0)),CASE WHEN i.alias IS NULL THEN rx_extract(i.name,'^[^.]+',0) ELSE i.name END FROM direct_imports i

stages.name: scope_shadows
stages.query: SELECT b.__path,coalesce((SELECT s.id FROM scope_nodes s WHERE s.__path=b.__path AND s.id<b.__start AND s.__end>=b.__end ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1) AS scope,b.name FROM bound_names b UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM plain_params p UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM typed_params p UNION SELECT s.__path,coalesce((SELECT s.id FROM scope_nodes s WHERE s.__path=s.__path AND s.id<s.__start AND s.__end>=s.__end ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1),-1),s.name FROM scope_nodes s UNION SELECT g.__path,-1,g.name FROM global_names g UNION SELECT n.__path,f.id,n.name FROM nonlocal_names n JOIN scope_nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.kind='function_definition' AND f.id<n.__start AND f.__end>=n.__end

stages.name: annotation_atoms
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,a.__start AS annotation,a.scope,'name:'||n.__start AS atom_id,n.__start AS atom_start,n.__end AS atom_end,n.text AS atom FROM name_atoms n JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.__start=n.ann_start UNION SELECT a.__path,a.__start,a.scope,'member:'||n.__start||':'||n.__end,n.__start,n.__end,CASE WHEN rx_matches(n.text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*$') THEN rx_replace(n.text,'\s+','') ELSE n.attr END FROM member_atoms n JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.__start=n.ann_start UNION SELECT a.__path,a.__start,a.scope,'quoted:'||q.__start||':'||q.atom,q.__start,q.__end,q.atom FROM quoted_atoms q JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=q.__path AND a.__start=q.ann_start

stages.name: atom_imports
stages.query: SELECT a.*,i.origin,c.depth,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scope_chain shadow_chain JOIN scope_shadows shadow ON shadow.__path=shadow_chain.__path AND shadow.scope=shadow_chain.ancestor AND shadow.name=i.name WHERE shadow_chain.__path=a.__path AND shadow_chain.scope=a.scope AND shadow_chain.depth<=c.depth) AS unshadowed FROM annotation_atoms a JOIN scope_chain c ON c.__path=a.__path AND c.scope=a.scope JOIN scope_imports i ON i.__path=c.__path AND i.scope=c.ancestor AND i.name=rx_extract(a.atom,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*',0) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scope_chain near JOIN scope_imports local ON local.__path=near.__path AND local.scope=near.ancestor AND local.name=i.name WHERE near.__path=a.__path AND near.scope=a.scope AND near.depth<c.depth)

stages.name: resolved_atoms
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id,a.atom_start,a.atom_end,a.atom,i.origin||substr(a.atom,length(rx_extract(a.atom,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*',0))+1) AS origin,i.unshadowed AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.origin) FROM atom_imports x WHERE x.__path=i.__path AND x.annotation=i.annotation AND x.atom_id=i.atom_id)=1 AS trusted FROM annotation_atoms a JOIN atom_imports i ON i.__path=a.__path AND i.annotation=a.annotation AND i.atom_id=a.atom_id UNION SELECT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id,a.atom_start,a.atom_end,a.atom,a.atom,0 FROM annotation_atoms a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom_imports i WHERE i.__path=a.__path AND i.annotation=a.annotation AND i.atom_id=a.atom_id)

stages.name: ignored_annotation_metadata
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id FROM resolved_atoms a JOIN (SELECT __path,__start,__end,ann_start,base_start,base_end,1 AS any_arg FROM any_args UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,ann_start,base_start,base_end,0 FROM later_args) g ON g.__path=a.__path AND g.ann_start=a.annotation AND a.atom_start>=g.__start AND a.atom_end<=g.__end JOIN resolved_atoms base ON base.__path=a.__path AND base.annotation=a.annotation AND base.atom_start=g.base_start AND base.atom_end=g.base_end AND base.trusted WHERE g.any_arg=1 AND base.origin IN ('typing.Literal','typing_extensions.Literal') OR g.any_arg=0 AND base.origin IN ('typing.Annotated','typing_extensions.Annotated')

relational.query: SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-050' AS issue,'callable:'||n.__start AS identity FROM annotations n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolved_atoms a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.annotation=n.__start AND rx_matches(a.origin,'(?:^|\.)Callable(?:\.|$)') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ignored_annotation_metadata ignored WHERE ignored.__path=a.__path AND ignored.annotation=a.annotation AND ignored.atom_id=a.atom_id)) UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-050' AS issue,'service:'||n.__start AS identity FROM annotations n WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resolved_atoms a WHERE a.__path=n.__path AND a.annotation=n.__start AND NOT (a.trusted AND a.origin IN ('data_layer.types.ConnectionId','l1350_foundational_types.ConnectionId','l1400_types.ConnectionId')) AND rx_matches(a.origin,'AsyncCapabilityTokenService|BackendExecutor|CapabilityTokenService|CapabilityTokenStore|Connection|Cursor|Hydrator|RuntimeBundle|SyncDatabaseConnection|TokenStore|Transaction') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ignored_annotation_metadata ignored WHERE ignored.__path=a.__path AND ignored.annotation=a.annotation AND ignored.atom_id=a.atom_id))

SELECT __path AS path,__start AS start_byte,__end AS end_byte,'SPQ-049' AS issue,__start AS identity FROM candidates WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates)>=2

stages.name: fn_spans
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,name FROM fns

stages.name: class_spans
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,name FROM classes

stages.name: module_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,CASE WHEN rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/') THEN replace(rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),'/','.') ELSE rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1) END AS qualified FROM (SELECT __path FROM classes UNION SELECT __path FROM fns)

stages.name: aliases
stages.query:
SELECT __path,__start,CASE WHEN kind='aliased_import' THEN alias ELSE text END AS local,trim(module,'.')||'.'||CASE WHEN kind='aliased_import' THEN iname ELSE text END AS origin FROM from_names
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,CASE WHEN kind='aliased_import' THEN alias ELSE rx_extract(text,'^([\w]+)',1) END,CASE WHEN kind='aliased_import' THEN iname ELSE text END FROM direct_names

stages.name: cclasses
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,c.name,m.qualified||'.'||c.name AS qualified_name FROM class_spans c JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=c.__path WHERE c.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM class_spans o WHERE o.__path=c.__path AND o.name=c.name)

stages.name: base_scan
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE scan(__path,cls,t,i,depth,buf,item) AS (SELECT __path,__start,substr(text,2,length(text)-2),1,0,'',NULL FROM class_sups
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,cls,t,i+1,CASE WHEN substr(t,i,1) IN ('(','[','{') THEN depth+1 WHEN substr(t,i,1) IN (')',']','}') THEN depth-1 ELSE depth END,
 CASE WHEN i>length(t) OR substr(t,i,1)=',' AND depth=0 THEN '' ELSE buf||substr(t,i,1) END,CASE WHEN i>length(t) OR substr(t,i,1)=',' AND depth=0 THEN buf END FROM scan WHERE i<=length(t)+1)
 SELECT __path,cls AS __start,trim(item,char(32,9,10,13)) AS text FROM scan WHERE item IS NOT NULL

stages.name: bases
stages.query: SELECT * FROM base_scan WHERE rx_matches(text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*$') OR rx_matches(text,'^[A-Za-z_][\w.\s]*\(') AND substr(text,-1)=')'

stages.name: class_bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.__start AS cls,coalesce((SELECT a.origin FROM aliases a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.local=rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1) AND a.__start<c.__start ORDER BY a.__start DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'^[\w]+((?:\.[\w]+)*)',1),'') AS name FROM cclasses c JOIN bases b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.__start=c.__start

stages.name: derived
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE derived(name) AS (SELECT 'l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' UNION SELECT c.qualified_name FROM cclasses c JOIN class_bases b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.__start JOIN derived d ON d.name=b.name) SELECT * FROM derived

stages.name: fn_owner
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,(SELECT c.__start FROM class_spans c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start<f.__start AND c.__end>=f.__end ORDER BY c.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS cls FROM fn_spans f

stages.name: cmethods
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,f.cls,c.qualified_name,c.qualified_name IN (SELECT name FROM derived) AS derived FROM fn_owner f JOIN cclasses c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start=f.cls WHERE f.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM fn_owner o WHERE o.__path=f.__path AND o.cls=f.cls AND o.name=f.name)

stages.name: cfunctions
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,m.qualified||'.'||f.name AS qualified_name FROM fn_owner f JOIN module_names m ON m.__path=f.__path WHERE f.cls IS NULL AND f.__start=(SELECT max(o.__start) FROM fn_owner o WHERE o.__path=f.__path AND o.cls IS NULL AND o.name=f.name)

stages.name: vtree
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,kind,text,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent FROM vnodes

stages.name: contract_blocks
stages.query: SELECT b.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY b.__path ORDER BY b.__end-b.__start,b.__start) AS sequence FROM vtree b JOIN cmethods m ON m.__path=b.__path AND m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' AND m.__start=(SELECT f.__start FROM fn_spans f WHERE f.__path=b.__path AND f.__start<b.__start AND f.__end>=b.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE b.kind='block'

stages.name: block_results
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE fold(__path,sequence,state) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,0,'{}' FROM contract_blocks UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.sequence,substr(fold.state,1,length(fold.state)-1)||CASE WHEN length(fold.state)>2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||json_quote(b.id)||':'||CAST((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vtree stmt WHERE stmt.__path=b.__path AND stmt.parent=b.id AND stmt.__start<=coalesce((SELECT min(barrier.__start) FROM vtree barrier WHERE barrier.__path=b.__path AND barrier.parent=b.id AND barrier.kind IN ('raise_statement','return_statement')),b.__end) AND (stmt.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(stmt.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)') OR stmt.kind='if_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vtree alternative WHERE alternative.__path=stmt.__path AND alternative.parent=stmt.id AND alternative.kind='else_clause') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child WHERE child.__path=stmt.__path AND (child.parent=stmt.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vtree arm WHERE arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.kind IN ('elif_clause','else_clause'))) AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1) OR stmt.kind='match_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vtree arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.kind='case_clause' AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child JOIN vtree arm ON arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.kind='case_clause' WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1)))) AS TEXT)||'}' FROM fold JOIN contract_blocks b ON b.__path=fold.__path AND b.sequence=fold.sequence+1) SELECT __path,state FROM fold WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(b.sequence) FROM contract_blocks b WHERE b.__path=fold.__path)

stages.name: always_raises
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.__start FROM cmethods m JOIN block_results r ON r.__path=m.__path JOIN vtree body ON body.__path=m.__path AND body.parent='function_definition:'||m.__start||':'||m.__end AND body.kind='block' WHERE m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' AND json_extract(r.state,'$."'||body.id||'"')=1

stages.name: method_returns
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.cls,m.name,r.kind,r.text FROM cmethods m JOIN int_returns r ON r.__path=m.__path AND r.__start>=m.__start AND r.__start<=m.__end AND r.__end<=m.__end WHERE m.name='level'

stages.name: owned_stores
stages.query: SELECT s.*,(SELECT f.__start FROM fn_spans f WHERE f.__path=s.__path AND f.__start<s.__start AND f.__end>=s.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS fn FROM self_stores s

stages.name: owned_compiles
stages.query: SELECT c.*,(SELECT f.__start FROM fn_spans f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.__start<c.__start AND f.__end>=c.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS fn FROM compile_calls c

stages.name: owned_controls
stages.query: SELECT c.*,(SELECT f.__start FROM fn_spans f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.__start<c.__start AND f.__end>=c.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS fn FROM controls c

stages.name: owned_declared
stages.query: SELECT d.*,(SELECT c.__start FROM class_spans c WHERE c.__path=d.__path AND c.__start<d.__start AND c.__end>=d.__end ORDER BY c.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS cls FROM declared d
